title: ATFLOR Cement Core Raised Floor Panel

items.h: Core / Material: Steel top & bottom sheets, cementitious infill
Concentrated Load Capacity (point load):  363 kg per panel
Anti-static / Static control: Yes — designed for data centers / computer / electronics rooms.

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The ATFLOR Cement Core Raised Floor Panel is a premium raised access flooring solution engineered for modern data centers, server rooms, control rooms, telecom facilities, and commercial office environments. Built with a high-strength welded steel shell and lightweight cementitious core, this raised floor panel delivers exceptional load-bearing performance, fire resistance, and long-term durability.

Designed to support heavy IT equipment while providing efficient underfloor cable management and airflow distribution, the ATFLOR Cement Core Raised Floor Panel is the ideal choice for businesses seeking reliable and professional raised flooring systems. Available with High Pressure Laminate (HPL), anti-static PVC, or bare steel finishes, it meets the demanding requirements of mission-critical environments.

D CORE supplies genuine ATFLOR raised floor panels in Bangladesh with competitive pricing, professional consultation, and dependable after-sales support.

Key Features


  • Heavy-duty cement core raised floor panel
  • Strong welded steel top and bottom sheets
  • Epoxy powder-coated finish for corrosion resistance
  • Excellent load-bearing capacity for IT infrastructure
  • Fire-resistant cementitious core construction
  • Supports underfloor cable management and cooling systems
  • Compatible with HPL, anti-static PVC, and bare finishes
  • Easy installation, maintenance, and panel replacement
  • Ideal for data centers, server rooms, and control rooms
  • Manufactured to international quality standards
